title: Report inappropriate reviews on your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help

facts.fact: Only reviews that violate Google policies are eligible for removal, although any review can be reported.
facts.quote: You can report any review, but only those that violate Google policies are eligible for removal.

facts.fact: Google advises merchants not to report a review just because they disagree with it or dislike it.
facts.quote: Do not report a review just because you disagree with it or dislike it.

facts.fact: Review evaluation of a reported review typically takes several days.
facts.quote: Review evaluation typically takes several days.

facts.fact: In the Reviews Management Tool, a single one-time appeal can cover up to 10 reviews.
facts.quote: You can select up to 10 reviews.

facts.fact: Merchants in the European Economic Area (EEA) can report third-party reviews directly on Google.
facts.quote: Merchants in the EEA can report third-party reviews directly on Google.

facts.fact: Google's automated spam detection can occasionally remove legitimate reviews by mistake.
facts.quote: Occasionally, the system may also mistakenly remove legitimate reviews.
